items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: The interviewer asks 'And did Tati play music?' and the interviewee (George Lewis) responds by describing Tati's band and presence ('Here comes Tati's band. He was very, very, very lively.'), indicating knowledge of the person but no stated personal interaction or collaboration.

ctx.x: Well, he was one of them. He had been, about six or sometimes 12 of them. And they would go around, they dressed in women, and they'd sing, and they'd sing.

No, he'd mass. Oh, but he'd... Massive. Lively, lively. Whenever you'd hear that, they could say that people would run, you know, those old folks, even those that was busy, that they would run. Here comes Tati's band. He was very, very, very lively. Oh, he made a good, good Mardi Gras.
